label: Prediction
inputs: history available strictly before a future target is revealed
required_behavior: forecast held-out future outcomes with a preregistered proper score better than the strongest history-restricted null
minimal_negative_twin: make the future conditionally independent of history given the parent information set + N0
strongest_parent: best base-rate or parent-information forecast using exactly the allowed pre-target information + P0
falsifier: proper-score advantage is nonpositive; target leakage occurs; calibration fails the preregistered tolerance; or the margin persists when history is made noninformative

label: Abstraction / concept formation
inputs: instances generated from latent equivalence classes or reusable task-relevant invariants
required_behavior: compress instances into a representation that preserves task utility and generalizes to held-out members/remints
minimal_negative_twin: assign independent task responses to every instance so no reusable equivalence class exists + N0
strongest_parent: best exemplar memorizer with no cross-instance sharing at the same storage/query budget + P0
falsifier: compression does not improve description length or transfer at matched utility; class labels leak; or the advantage persists when instances are unrelated

label: Compositional reasoning
inputs: known primitives/operators recombined into held-out compositions
required_behavior: solve unseen recombinations with performance above a whole-pattern lookup parent and maintain systematicity across remints
minimal_negative_twin: restrict evaluation to previously seen whole combinations or make composition labels directly identify answers + N0
strongest_parent: best memorizer over complete seen combinations with the same primitive training set + P0
falsifier: held-out recombination performance matches lookup; split leakage exposes combinations; or the advantage remains when no recombination is required

label: Hierarchical skill formation
inputs: sequential tasks with recurring useful subtrajectories at multiple temporal scales
required_behavior: reuse learned macro-actions/options to reduce planning/execution burden while preserving return
minimal_negative_twin: destroy subtrajectory recurrence so every useful sequence is unique + N0
strongest_parent: best flat controller/planner over primitive actions under the same total budget + P0
falsifier: hierarchical reuse gives no charged savings; macros encode task IDs; or the advantage persists after recurrence is destroyed

label: Planning
inputs: decision problems where present actions have delayed consequences and multiple future branches
required_behavior: choose actions using consequences beyond the strongest shorter-horizon parent and achieve lower regret at matched resources
minimal_negative_twin: make reward/action consequences one-step or supply a sufficient cached action + N0
strongest_parent: best policy measurable from current state plus the preregistered shorter-horizon/cached features + P0
falsifier: short-horizon parent matches return; simulator reveals future answers; or the advantage persists in the one-step twin

label: Exploration / information seeking
inputs: uncertain environments where some actions trade immediate reward for information useful later
required_behavior: choose informative actions when their expected future value exceeds immediate opportunity cost and improve net return
minimal_negative_twin: make observations action-independent or make latent uncertainty irreducible + N0
strongest_parent: best myopic exploit-only policy under the same action and observation budgets + P0
falsifier: informative actions do not improve later decisions net of cost; hidden parameters leak; or the advantage persists when actions cannot change information

label: Causal inference
inputs: observational and permitted interventional data from a causal task with held-out interventions
required_behavior: predict interventional outcomes or effects P(Y|do(X=x)) on held-out interventions beyond observational-association parents
minimal_negative_twin: remove confounding/selection so observational conditioning equals the target intervention distribution + N0
strongest_parent: best predictor using observational associations P(Y|X) and the same noninterventional information + P0
falsifier: held-out intervention error is not better; intervention labels leak outcomes; or the margin does not collapse when association equals intervention

label: Counterfactual reasoning
inputs: factual evidence about a unit plus a structural intervention query about that same unit
required_behavior: answer unit-level counterfactuals by preserving evidence-constrained exogenous state across the intervention
minimal_negative_twin: make the query identifiable from population-level interventional marginals without unit-specific abduction + N0
strongest_parent: best interventional predictor that does not condition on the unit's factual evidence beyond public covariates + P0
falsifier: unit-level counterfactual score matches the interventional parent; factual evidence leaks the answer directly; or the margin persists when abduction is unnecessary

label: Metacognition
inputs: first-order decisions plus opportunities to report confidence, defer, stop, or allocate extra computation
required_behavior: predict own error/uncertainty and use that estimate to improve selective risk or compute-allocation utility
minimal_negative_twin: equalize difficulty/cost so fixed confidence and fixed compute allocation are optimal + N0
strongest_parent: best calibration/allocation rule measurable from public task covariates and first-order outputs only + P0
falsifier: self-evaluation gives no incremental calibration/selective-risk gain; ground-truth correctness leaks before action; or advantage persists when adaptive control is unnecessary
